item.title: Brazilian bishop declares excommunication for Catholics who participate in “traditional” Masses
item.description: On February 11, the Archdiocese of Maceió announced that the celebration of the traditional Latin Mass according to the Missal of St. Pius V would be permitted exclusively in a single location: the São Vicente de Paulo Chapel, and only once a week. item.title: One in three Mexican bishops will be replaced by Pope Leo XIV between 2026 and 2027
item.description: The generational shift is also visible in the provenance of current appointments. As of the beginning of 2026, 52.5 percent of Mexico’s bishops and archbishops were appointed by Pope Francis, 27.6 percent by Benedict XVI, 17.2 percent by John Paul II, and just 2.6 percent by Leo XIV himself.
